newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Net sales of 141,200 MT were 84 percent above the previous week and three and two-fifths times the 4-week average. The major buyer was Japan (79,000 MT).
Sales of 34,500 MT for 1997/98 were all for Japan.
Exports of 85,700 MT were up 9 percent from the previous week, but down 11 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Mexico (43,000 MT) and Japan (24,400 MT).
